intervals.note: No dedicated collaboration-formation source found; start approximated to the earliest SuperCDMS project date in the INSPIRE registry (SuperCDMS-Soudan proposed 2005).

name: SuperCDMS Collaboration
notes: The official site names US national labs/universities plus partners in Canada, France, the UK and India (and funding support from Germany's DFG), but gives no specific institution or member count, so membership counts are left null rather than estimated.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists running the SuperCDMS dark matter search, first at the Soudan mine in Minnesota and now at SNOLAB in Canada.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the SuperCDMS cryogenic Si/Ge direct-detection programme; international membership spans the US, Canada, France, the UK and India per the collaboration's own site, with continuity from the earlier CDMS programme.
